Markets.title: Dalal Street Week Ahead: Nifty faces crucial 26,000–26,300 hurdle; eyes further consolidation
Markets.summary: The Nifty fell 0.75% last week and faces a critical resistance zone between 26,000 and 26,300. Analysts recommend a selective, stock-focused approach while IT and banking lead the market and metals and energy lag.

Markets.title: Jaiprakash Power Ventures, CarTrade Tech among 11 smallcap stocks that plunged the most in a year, but mutual funds raised stakes
Markets.summary: Mutual funds increased their stakes in 16 Nifty Smallcap 250 companies over five quarters despite significant share price declines. Data from ACE Equity highlights 11 major laggards, including Jaiprakash Power Ventures and CarTrade Tech, that experienced the steepest annual stock plunges while institutional holdings steadily grew.

Markets.title: Concurrent Gainers: 9 stocks that gain for 5 days in a row
Markets.summary: Nine BSE 500 stocks delivered gains in each of the five trading sessions between November 19 and 27. PB Fintech led these gaining stocks with a return of 16.66%.

Markets.title: Bond market to stay cautious ahead of RBI policy: Equirus
Markets.summary: The bond market will likely remain cautious due to persistent inflation and expected interest rate hikes. Analysts predict the RBI will increase rates by 25 basis points in its upcoming policy review.

Markets.title: From war premium to demand concerns: What is driving the sharp fall in crude oil prices?
Markets.summary: Crude oil prices have dropped sharply from September highs due to fading geopolitical risks and growing concerns over oversupply and slowing global demand. This market correction is being driven by rising non-OPEC production, resilient Middle Eastern exports, and weaker consumption expectations.

Geo-Political.title: Argentina's bid to stop Falkland Islands oil drilling rejected
Geo-Political.summary: Argentina attempted to block a joint venture by UK-Israeli companies from exploring for oil and gas near the Falkland Islands. An international body rejected Argentina's bid, allowing the drilling project to proceed as part of the ongoing sovereignty dispute.

Geo-Political.title: Two staff killed in Israeli strike on Gaza medical clinic, MSF says
Geo-Political.summary: Two staff members were killed in an Israeli military strike on a medical clinic in Gaza. The Israeli military stated it targeted Hamas terrorists, while the World Health Organization condemned the attack.

Geo-Political.title: OpenAI counter-sues Apple over alleged theft of trade secrets
Geo-Political.summary: OpenAI has filed a counter-suit against Apple, accusing the tech giant of stealing trade secrets using a former employee. The legal dispute escalates the ongoing tension between the two companies regarding artificial intelligence technology.

Geo-Political.title: Eight killed in Peruvian military helicopter crash
Geo-Political.summary: An eight-person Peruvian military helicopter crashed during a rescue mission in a remote, drug-trafficking region. The pilot was the sole survivor of the accident.

Data & Insights.title: Economy to sustain growth momentum in Dec quarter, but near-term inflation risks persist: finance ministry review
Data & Insights.summary: India's finance ministry expects the economy to maintain its growth momentum in the December quarter, driven by strong business activity, industrial output, and domestic demand. However, the ministry warned that weather changes, oil market volatility, and global trade uncertainties could pose near-term inflation risks.

Data & Insights.title: India inflation may rise in coming months amid festive demand, wedding season: Govt report
Data & Insights.summary: India's inflation may increase in the coming months due to high demand from the festive and wedding seasons, alongside supply uncertainties. However, lower crude oil prices and a stronger rupee are expected to help keep these price hikes in check.

Data & Insights.title: China Railway Resources Group bets on Zimbabwe's gold potential with AI mining and $600 million investment plan
Data & Insights.summary: China Railway Resources Group signed an agreement with Duration Gold to invest up to $600 million in reviving and expanding four gold mines in Zimbabwe. The partnership plans to introduce financing, engineering expertise, and AI-powered mining technology to sites including Vubachikwe and Gaika.

Data & Insights.title: RBI governor urges MSMEs to free-trade deals; flags low AI adoption
Data & Insights.summary: The RBI governor urged micro, small, and medium enterprises to leverage free-trade agreements to improve market access and integrate into global value chains. He also highlighted their low adoption of artificial intelligence as an area requiring attention.

Data & Insights.title: US tariffs: India gets an edge over China, Vietnam, Bangladesh—but what must New Delhi do to secure it?
Data & Insights.summary: The US has proposed a 17 percent tariff on Indian exports if a trade deal is reached, potentially giving India an advantage over Asian competitors. However, this offer requires India to meet specific demands regarding market access and trade policies through ongoing negotiations.

Data & Insights.title: South Korea raises rates to 2-year high as inflation and housing prices remain a worry
Data & Insights.summary: South Korea's central bank raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 3.25%, reaching a two-year high. The increase was driven by ongoing concerns over above-target inflation and rising housing prices in Seoul.

India.title: In Supreme Court-Appointed Judges' Presence, Deepam Lit On Madurai Hilltop Pillar
India.summary: A lamp was lit on the Madurai hilltop stone pillar in the presence of Supreme Court-appointed judges. Devotees celebrated the event by chanting religious slogans as the flame appeared.

India.summary: BRS has announced that its three MPs will vote in favour of the proposed Delimitation Bill. BRS Working President K T Rama Rao stated the bill addresses the party's concerns by including a safeguard that prevents changes to the inter-state representation ratio until 2051.
